result.reason: The redline improves the Deliverable conformance period and creates an express correction duty, but it does not reach either complete position. It omits the Services performance warranty, explicit software coverage, replacement and refund remedies, and—at the preferred level—compliance-with-laws and malicious-code warranties. The margin comment is non-operative, and the unavailable contents of Section 19.4 cannot establish the missing remedies. Because no complete level is achieved and the redline also adds Order Form specifications beyond the stated documentation requirement, it is not minimal, although it does not appear to impair unrelated commercial terms.
